description: A generated block's label is its value normalized to NFC
notes: The label is written as e followed by U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT, whose NFC form is U+00E9. Strings are equal under NFC in the spec, which doesn't say whether block labels are normalized (see native/structure/block-label-not-normalized, where a label written in a block header keeps its code points). hashicorp/hcl gives the generated block the string value of the label expression (expandSpec.newBlock in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go), and normalizes every string value to NFC (cty.StringVal in go-cty; see native/strings/decomposed-literal-text-is-normalized).
